convertibility_reason: Uses external Martingail.mqh library for position sizing with global variable persistence and lot doubling logic, plus OnTesterFunctions.mqh for custom tester metrics. Trading logic itself is simple but money management is external library-dependent.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Martingail library manages lot size: initial deposit fraction (DML/Shape) with configurable doubling count (Ud) after losses. Lot state persisted via global variables across restarts.

custom_logic_notes: Martingale position sizing via Martingail class: lot size doubles (configurable via Ud/DoublingCount) after losing trades, resets after a win. State persisted in global variables (GVarName='MG_1') so martingale sequence survives EA restarts. OnTester returns profit/loss ratio divided by max series loss+1 as custom optimization criterion, returning 0 if Tp<Stop (i.e. disqualifying R:R<1). New bar guard uses tick_volume>1 check (only trades on first tick of a new bar). EMA crossover uses previous bar values (index [1]) to detect cross while current bar values (index [0]) confirm direction.
python_conversion_notes: 1) Martingail.mqh must be manually translated - it manages lot doubling and global variable persistence. 2) The tick_volume>1 new-bar check is MT5 specific; replace with proper bar-change detection in Python. 3) SL/TP are set in points (Stop*Point(), Tp*Point()) - ensure pip/point conversion is correct for the symbol. 4) PositionSelect(_Symbol) means only one position at a time per symbol. 5) The OnTester custom metric (profit_c_divide_lossc / max_series_loss) is for MT5 strategy optimizer only - not needed for Python backtest but could be implemented as a custom score. 6) Entry crossover uses bar[1] vs bar[0] - ensure proper bar indexing in Python backtest.
